note: Scheme rules as published. Always verify on the official site before applying. Amounts are estimates.

schemes.name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (homes)
schemes.authority: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
rules: ₹30,000 per kW for the first 2 kW
Maximum ₹78,000 for systems of 3 kW and above
Grid-connected rooftop only: off-grid systems are not eligible
schemes.source: JBVNL CFA structure; Business Today, Jul 2026

schemes.name: PM Surya Ghar: group housing societies / RWAs
schemes.authority: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
rules: ₹18,000 per kW for common facilities, including EV charging
Capped at 3 kW per house in the society

schemes.name: PM-KUSUM Component A: solar plants on farmers' land
schemes.authority: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
rules: Grid-connected plants of 0.5–2 MW on barren or fallow farm land
Power sold to the DISCOM at a fixed tariff

schemes.name: PM-KUSUM Component B: standalone solar pumps
schemes.authority: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
rules: Standalone solar pumps up to 7.5 HP where there is no grid
30% central support plus a state share (example: Punjab 30% central + 30% state)
State shares differ: check your state nodal agency

schemes.name: PM-KUSUM Component C: solarising grid pumps and feeders
schemes.authority: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
rules: Individual grid-connected pumps, or whole agricultural feeders, solarised

schemes.name: Delhi state top-up for rooftop solar
rules: ₹10,000 per kW on top of PM Surya Ghar

transitionNote: PM-KUSUM version 1.0 closed on 31 Dec 2025; version 2.0 is awaited. Estimates use v1.0 rules for reference only.
openQuestions: Higher central support for north-eastern, hill and island states is not confirmed for the current schemes. No higher figure is shown until it is verified.
